scope: Condensed manual review of edited OrderFlow portfolio TSX/content, supported by production build, lint and browser/accessibility evidence. No refactor or new runtime behavior.

checks.assessment: Case study and evidence section render static local content on the server; no new fetch, async dependency chain, effects or render-time network call.

No new client directive, chart framework, listener or subscription was added. Existing homepage client boundary receives public static project content; local media uses Next Image with dimensions and controlled native video.
No hooks or mirrored state in the edited components. Bounded benchmark medians/ranges derive from actual three-trial groups during server rendering; percentiles stay separate.

No server action, authentication mutation or privileged fetch added. Public evidence is synthetic/sanitized; repository CTA requires verified public flag and URL; no credentials/private keys enter TSX props.

Semantic section headings, image alternatives, explicit dimensions, table captions/scoped headers, focusable bounded table region and descriptive links. Browser checks passed at375/768/1440 and200percent text; four recorded axe states have zero automated violations.
Build TypeScript and lint pass. Benchmark remains null until independently verified actual series is supplied; fixture-only render checks never wrote measurement data.

limitations: Bounded source review, not a comprehensive security or performance audit.
No web-vitals, network-budget or assistive-technology performance/conformance claim.
Optional populated benchmark must run the existing conditional browser assertions after final actual data is supplied.
